subject.title: fix: separate allowPluginSyntheticAuth from allowAuthProfileFallback in model auth

question: Should gateway-prepared model attempts that intentionally exclude stored auth profiles nevertheless be allowed to invoke installed providers’ synthetic credential hooks by default?
rationale: The patch intentionally widens the credential source available to those calls; source-level tests prove the parameter split but cannot establish the desired gateway trust boundary.

options.title: Approve the separated boundary
options.body: Confirm that plugin synthetic credentials are valid for gateway-prepared calls, then require redacted after-fix gateway proof before merge.

options.title: Keep prepared calls fail-closed
options.body: Retain the existing suppression for gateway-prepared calls and pursue a narrower provider or gateway-owned credential handoff instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the separated boundary
recommendation.body: Confirm that plugin synthetic credentials are valid for gateway-prepared calls, then require redacted after-fix gateway proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The affected path selects runtime credentials and falls within the repository’s authentication-sensitive review boundary.
